1 land acquisition proceedings with regard to land situated in Padmavathi Gardens layout @ Vasundara nagar Kothapallem Village, Renigunta Mandal, Tirupathi, Sri Balaji Revenue Division, Chittoor District in violation of the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitations and Resettlement Act, 2013 and pass IA NO: 1 OF 2016 (WPMP 9782 OF 2016  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the Respondents to not to proceed with acquisition of land property Padmavathi Gardens layout @ vasundara nagar Kothapallem Village, Renigunta Mandal, Tirupathi, Sri Balaji Revenue Division, Chittoor District and pass Counsel for the Petitioner:
 1. U SHANTHI BHUSHAN RAO Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. G RAMACHANDRA REDDY(SC FOR TUDA)
 2. GP FOR REVENUE (AP)
 3. MUNI REDDY PERURU (SC FOR TUDA)
The Court made the following ORDER:
As the learned counsel for the petitioner was not available on 19.7.2024 and 31.7.2024, the matter was directed to be listed under the caption "For Dismissal".
Even today also, though the matter is listed under the caption "For Dismissal", learned counsel for the petitioner is not available.
It seems that the petitioner is not interested to prosecute the matter.
2. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
No order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
NINALA JAYASURYA,J
